title: collapseThreads: total reflects page-local collapse, not full result-set thread count
description: email.rs:180-195 — when collapseThreads=true, the backend returns a page of N emails; collapse_by_thread deduplicates that page; then total = ids.len() (collapsed page count). If the full result set has 100 emails collapsing to 30 threads but the page has 20 emails collapsing to 15 threads, total=15 is wrong (should be 30). Also result.position is from the pre-collapse query and may not match the collapsed ids slice. Clients using total for pagination will loop forever or stop early.
